services.name: VDP_ClearTransitionPlanes
services.behavior: Writes zero to VDP destinations 0x40000010 and 0x40020010.

services.name: VDP_ClearVRAM_C000
services.behavior: Fills 0x800 words with zero beginning at VRAM address 0xC000.

services.name: VDP_ClearVRAM_E000
services.behavior: Fills 0x800 words with zero beginning at VRAM address 0xE000.

services.name: VDP_CopyFixedSceneHeader
services.behavior: Copies four words from ROM address 0x002A40 to VRAM address 0xF400.

conclusion: Scene/resource setup uses fixed, reusable VDP primitives for transition-plane clearing, two VRAM block clears, and a four-word fixed scene-header copy.
